mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attempt a WHERE a.student_id=#{studentId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted_student d WHERE d.student_id=a.student_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM answer ans LEFT JOIN judgment j ON j.answer_id=ans.id WHERE ans.attempt_id=a.id AND (j.process_status IS NULL OR j.process_status <> 'FAILED') ) )
